description: This file is a FastAPI application implementing a WebSocket chat interface with an HTML frontend, including WebSocket endpoint handling, cookie and token-based authentication, and client-side scripting for WebSocket communication.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Handles GET requests at root ('/') path and returns HTML content for WebSocket chat frontend.

methods.name: get_cookie_or_token( websocket: WebSocket, session: Annotated[str | None, Cookie()] = None, token: Annotated[str | None, Query()] = None, )
methods.description: Dependency function that retrieves either a session cookie or a token from query parameters, raising a WebSocket exception if neither is provided.

methods.name: websocket_endpoint( *, websocket: WebSocket, item_id: str, q: int | None = None, cookie_or_token: Annotated[str, Depends(get_cookie_or_token)], )
methods.description: WebSocket endpoint handling real-time messaging; accepts WebSocket connection, receives and sends messages, and utilizes session or token for authentication.
